prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an original 2x2 four-panel atlas, four distinct sequential scenes, for chapter 2 of a 1997 Chinese school mystery. Characters: Shen Cen, Chinese teenage girl with short black bob, blue-white tracksuit over burgundy sweater; Xu Zhao, tousled-haired boy in blue-white tracksuit, small gauze on his temple; Gu Yu, bespectacled male classmate. TL: after the bell, Shen Cen sits in warmly lit classroom with cool water cup, math paper and creased handwritten record; other students quietly work. TR: at worn dark green back classroom door, Gu Yu gives Shen Cen an independent observation note, mild tension; Xu Zhao inside tidies books. BR: distant factory-gate fork at night, two small bicyclists separate toward canteen and family housing, wet ground and smokestacks fading in mist, canvas bag zipper closed. Exact 2x2 grid with clean dark dividers. No readable text, captions, watermarks, smartphones, modern gear, fantasy effects, or fabricated evidence.
inspection: Approved after visual inspection: four separate end-of-chapter scenes with schoolwork, Gu Yu's note, ordinary bicycle-chain repair, and two riders separating at the factory road. No legible evidence text or modern objects.
